summary: Online grounding for rev0136 downstream trace identity receipts: exact local HF snapshot path and digest-bound provenance should survive evaluation, selector, replay, and handoff, not stop at verifier acceptance.

sources.observed: Transformers supports offline/local loading from a local directory with local_files_only once files are downloaded.
snapshot_download materializes a repository snapshot and can pin a revision.
HF cache locations are configurable, so receipts should avoid relying on implicit cache resolution.
SLSA provenance models how an artifact was produced and supports consumer verification.
in-toto link descriptors require names and digests, matching the need for digest-bound downstream trace identity.

applied_change: Add public_trace_downstream_identity_receipt_v1 so accepted trace identity is compacted into trace_identity_sha256 and cross-checked across evaluation, selector-entry, replay, and handoff archive gates.
